title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific study nooks, quiet terraces, and student-centered lounges that define daily life at Agnes Scott College beyond the standard tour route.

cards.title: The Fireplace Nook
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Cozy up by the grand fireplace in the Main Reading Room. It is a favorite spot for students to curl up with a blanket during winter study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A cozy study area featuring a grand fireplace and comfortable seating in the library's main hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Reading Room on Floor 1 of McCain Library features couches by a fireplace where students are known to study and even use blankets.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; accessible to all students with a valid ID.

cards.title: The Rocking Chair Terrace
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 1
cards.notes: Head to this outdoor terrace to find rocking chairs and reliable WiFi. It is a designated spot where students can take cell phone calls or study in the fresh air.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor library terrace equipped with rocking chairs and WiFi for fresh-air studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elizabeth Henderson Cameron Reading Terrace features rocking chairs and WiFi, and is noted as a place to take cell phone calls.
cards.source_title: Favorite Study Spots in McCain Library
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space accessible through the library during operating hours.

cards.title: The Scenic Half-Moon Couch
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Look for the half-moon couch in this room for a scenic view of the Science Quad. It offers a quieter alternative to the main floors for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor reading room with a signature half-moon couch and views of the Science Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: The Elmore Reading Room on the ground floor features scenic seating facing the Science Quad and a half-moon couch.
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of McCain Library; accessible via stairs or elevator.

cards.title: The Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: Affectionately called the 'Fireplace Lounge,' this spot in the Alston Campus Center is perfect for quiet reading or small student gatherings with campus views.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable campus center lounge known for its grand fireplace and picturesque views.
cards.evidence_claim: The Amelia Davis Luchsinger Lounge is affectionately dubbed the 'Fireplace Lounge' and features comfortable furniture and campus views.
cards.source_title: Small Group Venues | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Located within the Wallace McPherson Alston Campus Center; open to students daily.

cards.title: The Hidden Alcove
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floor 3
cards.notes: Seek out the hidden alcove on the third floor for what students call the 'best seats in the house.' It is a prime spot for silent, uninterrupted study.
cards.short_summary: A secluded third-floor alcove designated for silent study and highly prized by students.
cards.evidence_claim: McCain Library's third floor contains a 'Hidden Alcove' described as having the 'best seats in the house' for silent study.
cards.access_notes: Floor 3 is a designated silent study floor; please maintain quiet in this area.

cards.title: The Commuter Hub
cards.subtitle: Alston Campus Center
cards.notes: A dedicated space for commuter students to relax between classes. It features lockers and comfortable seating to make campus life easier for those living off-site.
cards.short_summary: A specialized lounge in the campus center providing lockers and relaxation space for commuters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Alston Campus Center provides lounges specifically for commuter students along with lockers for their use.
cards.source_title: Commuter Student Information | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Primarily for commuter students; lockers can be checked out at the Hudson Center.

cards.title: The Science Atrium
cards.subtitle: Bullock Science Center
cards.notes: This bright, multi-story atrium is a central meeting point in the Bullock Science Center. It is a popular spot for students to gather before labs or for group projects.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, light-filled atrium serving as the social and collaborative heart of the science building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Brown Bullock Science Center features the Baker Atrium as a highlighted facility for gatherings.
cards.source_title: Small Group Venues | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: The Campbell Atrium
cards.subtitle: Campbell Hall
cards.notes: Located in the renovated Campbell Hall, this atrium provides a modern space for students living in the STEM learning community to connect and study.
cards.short_summary: A modern atrium in Campbell Hall that supports the building's living-learning community.
cards.evidence_claim: John Burlow Campbell Hall houses the Jones Center Atrium, which serves as a key facility in the building.
cards.source_title: Small Group Venues | Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents of Campbell Hall and students using the Jones Center services.

cards.title: The Stairwell Nooks
cards.subtitle: McCain Library, Floors 1 & 2
cards.notes: Don't overlook the landings in the front stairwell. These reading nooks offer unique, semi-private seating with views of the campus quad.
cards.short_summary: Quiet reading nooks located on the landings of the library's front stairwell.
cards.evidence_claim: McCain Library features reading nooks in the front stairwell on Floors 1 and 2, including a bay window landing.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the main front stairwell of the library.

cards.title: The Quad Hammocks
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Quad
cards.notes: The heart of campus is more than just a walkway. Students often hang hammocks here to relax between classes or participate in weekly outdoor yoga sessions.
cards.short_summary: The central campus green space used for relaxation, hammocking, and community yoga.
cards.evidence_claim: The Woodruff Quad is used by students for hanging out in hammocks and participating in weekly yoga sessions.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; hammocks are student-provided or checked out from Campus Rec.
